title: IOGP Life-Saving Rules
publisher: International Association of Oil & Gas Producers
usage_note: Rule relevance is not proof that a rule was violated. IOGP wording is preserved for identification; this prototype does not reproduce the official icons.

rules.name: Bypassing Safety Controls
rules.official_action: Obtain authorisation before overriding or disabling safety controls
assessment_points: Use the safety-critical equipment and procedures that apply to the task
Obtain authorisation before disabling or overriding safety equipment
Obtain authorisation before deviating from procedures

rules.name: Confined Space
rules.official_action: Obtain authorisation before entering a confined space
assessment_points: Confirm energy sources are isolated
Confirm the atmosphere is tested and monitored
Use breathing apparatus when required
Confirm an attendant and rescue plan are in place
Obtain authorisation to enter

rules.name: Driving
assessment_points: Wear a seatbelt
Do not exceed the speed limit and reduce speed for conditions
Do not use a phone while driving
Be fit, rested and fully alert
Follow journey-management requirements

rules.name: Energy Isolation
rules.official_action: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins
assessment_points: Identify all energy sources
Confirm hazardous energy is isolated, locked and tagged
Check zero energy and test for residual or stored energy

rules.name: Hot Work
assessment_points: Identify and control ignition sources
Confirm flammable material is removed or isolated and authorisation is obtained
In a hazardous area, confirm gas is tested and monitored

rules.name: Line of Fire
rules.official_action: Keep yourself and others out of the line of fire
assessment_points: Position people to avoid moving objects, vehicles, pressure releases and dropped objects
Establish and obey barriers and exclusion zones
Secure loose objects and report potential dropped objects

rules.name: Safe Mechanical Lifting
rules.official_action: Plan lifting operations and control the area
assessment_points: Confirm lifting equipment and loads are inspected and fit for purpose
Use qualified operators
Establish and obey barriers and exclusion zones
Do not walk under a suspended load

rules.name: Work Authorisation
rules.official_action: Work with a valid permit when required
assessment_points: Confirm whether a permit is required
Be authorised to perform the work
Understand the permit
Confirm hazards are controlled and it is safe to start
Stop and reassess if conditions change

rules.name: Working at Height
rules.official_action: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height
assessment_points: Inspect fall-protection equipment
Secure tools and materials
Tie off completely when outside a protected area
